description: This file defines an authentication store using Pinia, a state management library in Vue.js. It manages user login state, including storing user data in localStorage, providing login and logout actions, and a getter to check authentication status.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates user via provided credentials, stores user info in localStorage, and updates the store state.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Removes user data from localStorage and resets the user state to null.
